min_castable_wire_diameter_mm.notes: THE HIGHEST-VALUE NUMBER IN THE REPOSITORY. Goal 0021 measured the whole envelope: thinnest exposed section runs 0.157 mm at a 3 mm stone to 0.575 mm at the 11 mm maximum, so ask 'which of these can you cast?' rather than 'is 0.6 mm ok?'. Refused five times over as shipped: record undeclared, finding undeclared, evidence_class unknown, unattributed, undated.

min_prong_base_diameter_mm.notes: F3. MyJewl's approved reference is 0.600 mm at the ~1 ct stone; a single unverified source says the trade standard is 1.0-1.3 mm. If that holds, the production reference holds a one-carat diamond in roughly melee-gauge wire. Do NOT lead with our number -- ask theirs first, then show ours.

min_feature_separation_mm.notes: Governs petal and prong spacing before adjacent features fuse in casting. Nothing in MyJewl checks it today.
